shared_elements: incised linear signs or geometric markings
horizontal bands or rows of decoration
justification: The main overlap is only generic: both surfaces include incised anthropomorphic imagery together with circular motifs and linear/sign-like decoration. A is a single highly abstract frontal body-like figure with symmetrical circular and arcing motifs, while B is a register-like scene with profile human figures interacting and rows of script-like signs, so the depicted schemes are fundamentally different.
